ceded, then, that Love loves that which he wants but possesses not?” — “Yes, certainly.” — “But Love
wants and does not possess beauty?” — “Indeed it must necessarily follow” ’ (Julian vii 195). Later
in the dialogue, Socrates reports the words of the prophetess Diotima on the true lover’s pursuit of
eternal and perfect Beauty through the various manifestations of the beautiful (Julian vii 205–7). In
